```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "BW is 3x short because the symmetric 5T OTA turns only Itail/2 into gm. Switch to a ratioed pair (M1:M2 = M3:M4 = 1:N) so Gm = gm2 = N/(N+1)·Itail·gm/Id. Use short L. Correct the tail mirror W with the forward model and cut Itail to fix the power overshoot."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),
    "L_in":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),
    "gmid_p":  (9.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_p":     (0.18, 0.15, 0.6),
    "Itail":   (50e-6, 30e-6, 62e-6),
    "N":       (4.0, 2.0, 7.0),
    "Rf":      (150e3, 40e3, 600e3),
    "Cf":      (100e-15, 30e-15, 400e-15),
    "gtrim":   (1.0, 0.96, 1.04),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail = min(p["Itail"], 132e-6 / vdd - iref)
    itail = max(itail, 5e-6)
    N = p["N"]
    i1 = itail / (N + 1.0)
    i2 = itail * N / (N + 1.0)

    # ratioed NMOS pair, equal current density so balance occurs at vn = vcm
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], i2, vds=0.45, vsb=0.4)
    vtail = 0.9 - m2.vgs
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], i2, vds=0.9 - vtail, vsb=max(vtail, 0.0))
    vtail = 0.9 - m2.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], i1, vds=0.9 - vtail, vsb=max(vtail, 0.0))
    # ratioed PMOS mirror (same L, gm/Id)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], i1, vds=0.9)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], i2, vds=0.9)

    # tail / reference mirror, W corrected with forward model at actual vds
    Lt, gt = 1.0, 10.0
    m_r = lut.size("n", gt, Lt, iref, vds=0.6)
    m_r = lut.size("n", gt, Lt, iref, vds=m_r.vgs)
    vds_t = max(vtail, 0.15)
    m_t = lut.size("n", gt, Lt, itail, vds=vds_t)
    chk = lut.op("n", m_t.W, Lt, m_r.vgs, vds_t)
    Wt = m_t.W * itail / max(chk["Id"], 1e-9)

    # loop gain with feedback loading
    Rf = p["Rf"]
    g1t, g2t = 0.1571, 0.01797
    k1, k2 = g1t, g2t
    Gm = m2.gm
    A = 10.0
    for _ in range(6):
        Rp = Rf / (k1 + k2)
        gl = m2.gds + m4.gds + 1.0 / (Rf + Rp)
        A = Gm / gl
        fix = 1.0 + (1.0 + k1 + k2) / A
        k1 = g1t * fix * p["gtrim"]
        k2 = g2t * fix * p["gtrim"]
    R1 = Rf / k1; R2 = Rf / k2
    Cf = p["Cf"]; C1 = k1 * Cf; C2 = k2 * Cf

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_r)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, Lt)
    n.dev("M1", "xd", "vcm", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vn", "tail", "vss", m2)
    n.dev("M3", "xd", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vn", R1); n.C("C1", "vin1", "vn", C1)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vn", R2); n.C("C2", "vin2", "vn", C2)
    n.R("RF", "vn", "vout", Rf); n.C("CF", "vn", "vout", Cf)

    a1 = -k1 / (1.0 + (1.0 + k1 + k2) / A)
    a2 = -k2 / (1.0 + (1.0 + k1 + k2) / A)
    cin = m2.cgg
    beta_hf = Cf / (Cf + C1 + C2 + cin)
    cser = Cf * (C1 + C2 + cin) / (Cf + C1 + C2 + cin)
    cout = cl + cser + m2.cdd + m4.cdd
    gbw = Gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd))
    bw_raw = gbw * beta_hf
    # mirror carries N/(N+1) of signal -> doublet, partial pole effect
    frac = N / (N + 1.0)
    bw = bw_raw / math.sqrt(1.0 + (frac * bw_raw / fp2) ** 2)
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(bw_raw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(bw_raw / ((N + 1) * fp2)))
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": a2, "bw": bw, "power": power,
               "vout_offset": 0.0, "A_ol_db": db(A), "pm_deg": pm,
               "fp2": fp2, "vtail": vtail, "Gm": Gm}
```
